title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 20. Welcomes the Ombudsman’s decision to open an inquiry into the Commission’s data collection on the impact of the wolf population in the EU; notes, however, that in accordance with the Ombudsman’s statute, the inquiry had to be closed due to a pending case before the CJEU (T-634/24), where the same issues are raised; expresses deep concern that the decision to downgrade the protected status of wolves, which lacks sound scientific evidence and is aggravated by a lack of public access to documents and insufficient efforts to implement adequate preventive measures, at odds with the provisions of the Bern Convention, created a troubling precedent, endangering the overall approach to conservation goals and the management of wildlife and natural habitats;
